programme.desc: Sarah Plummer, agente del FBI, ve cómo su familia es secuestrada durante un vuelo a Washington. Cuando una misteriosa pasajera se sienta a su lado, deberá tomar una decisión que puede costarle la vida de su marido y su hijo.

programme.title: El juego de Ender
programme.desc: Harrison Ford, Asa Butterfield, Hailee Steinfeld, Ben Kingsley, Viola Davis y Abigail Breslin protagonizan esta aventura de ciencia ficción repleta de acción basada en la novela superventas.

programme.title: Infinitum
programme.desc: Jane debe cambiar su realidad en un universo paralelo por su cuenta.

programme.title: Oceans Rising
programme.desc: Un científico construye un arca enorme después de que se ignoran sus advertencias de una inundación que destruirá la Tierra.

programme.title: San Andreas mega seísmo
programme.desc: Los científicos descubren algo horrible: el "Gran Terremoto" será en dos días y hundirá California en el océano. Su única esperanza es romper un volcán que desplazará la energía del terremoto y construirá una nueva corteza en la superficie.

programme.title: La era del mañana
programme.desc: Cuando el sol golpea un altar, escondido dentro de la antigua Pirámide del Sol en México, se crea un faro que desencadena una guerra relámpago alienígena. En cuestión de horas, sus platillos destruyen toda la infraestructura militar de la tierra.

programme.title: Tentáculos de las Bermudas
programme.desc: Cuando el Air Force One cae sobre el Triángulo de las Bermudas, la Marina envía su mejor equipo de rescate. Pero mientras salvan el presidente, el equipo despierta a una criatura que amenaza a toda la costa este.

programme.title: Super Collider
programme.desc: Cuando un super colisionador de hadrones genera un desplazamiento temporal, por culpa de su funcionamiento defectuoso, un científico solitario debe restablecer el orden natural antes de que el mundo se destruya por completo.

programme.title: ¡Alarma vuelo 502 secuestrado!
programme.desc: Un Boeing 707 hace un viaje rutinario entre Los Ángeles y Minneapolis. En pleno viaje, un veterano de la guerra de Vietnam, que parece enloquecido, secuestra el avión y obliga a desviar su trayectoria hacia Rusia.

programme.title: Batalla de Los Ángeles
programme.desc: En febrero de 1942, las fuerzas estadounidenses se enfrentaron a un OVNI sobre Los Ángeles. Hoy, después de casi 70 años, los invasores alienígenas han regresado.

programme.title: Casos Sin Resolver
programme.desc: El 26 de marzo de 2001, Magalie Part, una joven de 19 años que vivía en Ornex, en el departamento francés de Ain, salió a comprar cigarrillos con su perro.

programme.title: El Caso de mi Vida: El Caso Giraud-L'Herbier
programme.desc: En 2004, una pareja de mujeres desaparece.

programme.title: El Caso de mi Vida: La Corredora de Milly-La-Forêt
programme.desc: En septiembre de 2009, Marie-Christine Hodeau, una corredora, es secuestrada y encerrada en el maletero del coche de su secuestrador.

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Trampa mortal en el bosque - Christophe Belle
programme.desc: El 19 de marzo de 1998, Akira Ojima, un arquitecto japonés de 57 años, aparece muerto en la nevera de una villa de Nanterre.
programme.sub-title: Trampa mortal en el bosque - Christophe Belle

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Misteriosas desapariciones en París - Christelle Leroy
programme.desc: El 21 de marzo de 1991, Pascale Escarfail, de 19 años, es descubierta muerta en su estudio en el distrito 14 de París.
programme.sub-title: Misteriosas desapariciones en París - Christelle Leroy

programme.title: Evidencias del Crimen: Sólo el ADN puede decir - Angélique Dumetz
programme.desc: El 23 de febrero de 2017, la policía es alertada de la desaparición de Brigitte Troadec y su familia
programme.sub-title: Sólo el ADN puede decir - Angélique Dumetz

programme.title: The Prosecutors: In Pursuit of Justice: Venganza mortal
programme.desc: A principios de los años 80 en el sur de Florida, se declaró una guerra importante contra las drogas ilegales.

programme.title: The Prosecutors: In Pursuit of Justice: La heredera desaparecida
programme.desc: En febrero de 1977, Helen Vorhees Brach salió de la famosa Clínica Mayo en Minnesota y se adentró en las páginas del folklore de Chicago.

programme.title: The Prosecutors: In Pursuit of Justice: Error Fatal
programme.desc: Una excursión familiar en las montañas del pintoresco Oregón terminó con la fatal caída de Joyce Boyd.

programme.title: The Prosecutors: In Pursuit of Justice: Temperamento Asesino
programme.desc: Robert Peernock era un experto en pirotecnia que sabía cómo hacer estallar las cosas. Pero cuando trató de matar a su esposa e hija arreglando su auto para que explotara, algo salió mal y su hija sobrevivió.

programme.title: Crímenes Audaces: El Robo al Hotel Pierre
programme.desc: Cinco hombres vestidos de esmoquin ingresan al lobby del lujoso Hotel Pierre de Manhattan, esposan a diecinueve huéspedes y empleados y salen con $ 10 millones en gemas y efectivo.

programme.title: Crímenes Audaces: El Gran Asalto del Tren
programme.desc: Una pandilla de quince de los más grandes ladrones de Inglaterra detiene el tren del correo real y se marcha con 120 bolsas de correo que contienen un estimado de $ 5 millones en facturas imposibles de rastrear.

programme.title: Homicidio en Hollywood: OJ Simpson
programme.desc: La policía acusa al icono de fútbol americano OJ Simpson del asesinato de su exesposa y de su amigo, la investigación lleva a Tom Lange a un mundo de drogas, violencia y tensiones raciales, donde se enfrenta a OJ y su poder de celebridad.

programme.title: Homicidio en Hollywood: Dorothy Stratten
programme.desc: Cuando los cuerpos de la modelo de Playboy Dorothy Stratten y su esposo aparecen muertos en su casa de Los Ángeles, el detective de homicidios Richard DeAnda se ve envuelto en un oscuro caso de sicarios y pesos pesados de Hollywood.

programme.title: Clarividentes
programme.desc: Un hombre de California encuentra a sus vecinos ancianos asesinados en su propia casa. En Ohio, la policía investiga un sangriento ataque, pero no encuentra a la víctima. Un par de psíquicos se unen para ayudar.

programme.title: Atrapen a mi Asesino
programme.desc: En 1980, Marlene Major desaparece dejando a sus dos hijos. Su familia cree que huyó por escapar de su esposo violento. Solo hay un hombre que sabe su paradero y la verdad probará ser mucho más oscura de lo que nadie podría pensar.

programme.title: FBI Takedown
programme.desc: Las Fuerzas de Operaciones Especiales del FBI encaran uno de los retos más difíciles hasta ahora: atrapar a una banda de ladrones profesionales dispuestos a matar y retar al código de silencio hermético de uno de los vecindarios más rudos de Boston.

programme.title: Viví con un asesino: Sammy "el Toro" Gravano
programme.desc: Karen es la orgullosa hija de Sammy el Toro, un mafioso poderoso de Nueva York. Todo se derrumba cuando Sammy testifica para el gobierno y cambia la historia del crimen organizado de Nueva York. Pero no pensó en el impacto en la vida de su hija.

programme.title: Cíclope Extraterrestre: El Extraordinario Caso de la Sagrada Familia
programme.desc: En 1963 en Brasil, tres niños son testigos de un OVNI en su patio trasero. Un cíclope alienígena desciende y el Sr. Alberto investiga el fenómeno.

programme.title: Extraterrestres en la URSS
programme.desc: Misterios alienígenas sin resolver de la Unión Soviética: incidente del Paso Dyatlov, milagro de Petrozavodsk, caso Voronezh. Asombro y miedo, pero duda de la participación alienígena.

programme.title: Linda Napolitano: La Abducción Alienígena del Siglo
programme.desc: La abducción alienígena de Linda Napolitano en 1989 es el caso de abducción del siglo.

programme.title: Extraterrestres Ancestrales: El Origen de la Humanidad
programme.desc: La creciente evidencia y los avistamientos de ovnis sugieren contacto con seres extraterrestres que pueden haber influido en los orígenes de la vida humana.

programme.title: OVNIs Nazis
programme.desc: Se rumorea que la Alemania Nazi desarrolló naves espaciales avanzadas y que científicos continuaron en bunkers en la Antártida y Sudamérica. Sin evidencia, la teoría mezcla esoterismo y restauración nazi paranormal.

programme.title: El Incidente del Lago Falcon
programme.desc: Los extraterrestres visitan la Tierra a menudo; Destaca el incidente OVNI de 1967 en el lago Falcón de Canadá. Los frecuentes avistamientos de Canadá lo hacen enigmático.

programme.title: Avistamientos Masivos de Extraterrestres: La Verdad Innegable
programme.desc: El documental analiza los avistamientos masivos de extraterrestres, cuestiona la fiabilidad de las explicaciones oficiales e identifica patrones comunes para una mayor investigación.

programme.title: Tecnología alienígena: TR-3B y Big Black Deltas
programme.desc: El TR-3 Black Manta es descrito como un avión espía secreto, vinculado a tecnología antigravedad de origen extraterrestre. Su silueta triangular, oscura y veloz lo convierte en una de las aeronaves más enigmáticas del fenómeno OVNI.

programme.title: Extraterrestres entre Nosotros: La Teoría de Michael Wolf
programme.desc: Michael K. Wolf comparte 30 años de ideas sobre ovnis, extraterrestres, proyectos gubernamentales y círculos de las cosechas.

programme.title: Extraterrestres Subterráneos, Baba Vanga y Biología Cuántica
programme.desc: Baba Vanga, una mística búlgara ciega, hizo predicciones desde los 12 años hasta su muerte en 1996. Sus profecías se extendieron hasta el año 5079.

programme.title: El Accidente OVNI en Roswell
programme.desc: Encubrimientos y conspiraciones... ¿Qué sucedió realmente esa noche en Roswell, en 1947?

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: De allí para aquí
programme.desc: Introducción a la serie y estudio de la Tierra desde la órbita. El cielo está plagado de estrellas e innumerables galaxias. Es de dónde venimos y donde estamos destinados a regresar.

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: El regreso a la luna
programme.desc: La luna, nuestra compañera celestial más cercana. Nuestro compañero de baile indispensable a través del cosmos. Iluminando nuestro cielo nocturno y tirando suavemente de nuestras costas.

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: Los planetas interiores
programme.desc: Orbitan entre nosotros y nuestra Estrella, los mundos internos; escondido dentro del resplandor del sol a menudo solo visible al amanecer o al atardecer.

programme.title: Fronteras inexploradas: Próxima parada: Marte
programme.desc: Ha disparado nuestra imaginación durante milenios, Marte, el Dios de la Guerra y la fuente de la desaparición de la ciencia ficción del hombre.

programme.title: Señales de OVNIs en la Historia Humana
programme.desc: Gracias a la extensa investigación realizada por el erudito Ivan Ceci, hemos descubierto numerosos avistamientos de OVNIs que datan desde el 300 a.C. hasta la actualidad. Este notable hallazgo fue posible gracias a una minuciosa investigación.

programme.title: Mopias

programme.title: Mopias

programme.title: Lucky Peterson & The Organization
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. In 2019, one of these artists is the legendary bluesman Lucky Peterson, master of the blues guitar and Hammond organ, who celebrates 50 years on stage. Peterson is accompanied by his band The Organization, augmented by the talented vocalist Tamara Tramell. In a singular performance, she offers a fascinating mix of southern soul and modern R&B, exploring the limits of blues and funk.

programme.title: Mike Stern
programme.sub-title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis' comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Gerry Mulligan, Dave Glenn, Harold Danko & Ed Neumeister
programme.sub-title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Mulligan was one of the leading arrangers of the cool jazz era, who worked with Miles Davis, Stan Kenton and Claude Thornhill in the 1950s and 1960s. Mulligan's early pianoless 1950s quartet with trumpeter Chet Baker is still regarded as one of the finest groups in cool jazz. Born in New York in 1927, Mulligan spent his life composing, arranging and playing jazz until his death on January 20, 1996.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims. "Sounds from the Ancestors" his latest album, reflects the rich history of jazz, R&B and gospel music from the saxophonist's hometown of Detroit. But more importantly, it also has a modern cosmopolitan vibe, including music from France, Cuba, Nigeria and Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa & Maurizio Baglini
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni's Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong Liszt's Two Elegies for cello and piano Chopin's Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3 and Rachmaninoff's Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein's iconic composition ‘Tonight' from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Teodor Currentzis, Patricia Kopatchinskaja & Ensemble Musica Aeterna
programme.sub-title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm', as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Led Zeppelin
programme.desc: This is a documentary film about the build-up, making, release, and - crucially - music contained on this most revered of albums. With the aid of rare and classic performances, scarce interviews, seldom seen photographs and contributions from those involved in the making of the record - plus the review and critique from a panel of Zeppelin experts - this program finally lifts the lid on what many believe to be Led Zep's very finest offering. With contributions from the album's engineer, Ron Nevison former Yardbird, Chris Dreja Swansong recording artist, Maggie Bell author of The Rough Guide to Led Zeppelin, Nigel Williamson Tight But Loose editor, Dave Lewis Classic Rock Magazine's Malcolm Dome renowned guitar tutor and author, Rikky Rooksby and Robert Plant biographer, Neil Daniels. This is the complete story behind what what Rolling Stone called "their Tommy, Beggar's Banquet and Sgt. Pepper rolled into one".

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Rush's 'Time Machine' shows in 2010/11 were one of the most anticipated tours ever. Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centrepiece of the concerts. The shows also featured favourite tracks from across their lengthy career and two recent ones. As ever the concerts were a visual feast and sounded great with the band playing at the top of their form.

Then they must stand up to the local bully who wants to claim the dog as his own.

programme.title: I Kill Giants
programme.desc: Barbara Thorson (Madison Wolfe) is a teenage girl who escapes the realities of school and a troubled family life by retreating into her magical world of fighting evil giants. With the help of her new friend Sophia (Sydney Wade) and her school counsellor (Zoe Saldana), Barbara learns to face her fears and battle the giants that threaten her world.

programme.title: Push
programme.desc: Riveting Sci-Fi action-thriller Push is set in a deadly world of psychic espionage where the ability to move objects using only the mind, see the future, create new realities and kill without ever touching the victim can turn a person into a lethal weapon - or a target. A young man (Chris Evans - Sunshine, Fantastic Four ) and a teenage girl with extraordinary gifts (Dakota Fanning - War of the Worlds) take on a clandestine agency in a battle they can win only if they change the future.

programme.title: Love N' Dancing
programme.desc: Jessica (Amy Smart) had given up on her dream of a life of the stage, until she meets ex-dance champion Jake (Tom Malloy), who becomes her teacher when the couple make an instant connection. Together, they decide to risk it all when they enter the World Swing Championship to reclaim Jake's former title.

programme.title: Robot Overlords
programme.desc: Welcome to the ultimate battle between robots and mankind! When teenager Sean (Callan McAuliffe: The Great Gatsby) sets out to join the Resistance, against the robots, the fate of the world lies in his hands. Hot on his heels however, is robot collaborator Mr. Smythe (Ben Kingsley: Iron Man 3). This exhilarating British sci-fi thriller, delivers a bombastic robot takeover that is not to be missed!

programme.title: Fall of a Kingdom
programme.desc: Game of Thrones meets Braveheart. This historical actioner follows a 13th century freedom fighters as they battle for their lives and liberty in the face of the brutal Mongolian Empire. As war breaks out, both sides suffer devastation. Redoubling his efforts, Burunda Khan the Mongolian general - unleashes the full fury of his force. Starring Robert Patrick, Tommy Flanagan and Poppy Drayton.

programme.title: David & Goliath
programme.desc: Expect bloodshed, epic action sequences and sheer fearlessness, in the greatest story ever told! At the crossroads of two great ancient empires, a innocent shepherd named David transforms into a powerful warrior and takes on a terrifyingly violent giant named Goliath. One of history's most legendary Biblical battles is retold in a stylistic, bloody tale of courage and faith.

programme.title: Mythica: The Necromancer
programme.desc: A non-stop action fantasy that will transport you into a world of sorcerers, trolls and witches. When her most loyal friend is taken hostage by the cruel master of the Thieves Guild, Marek embarks on a corrupt mission. But when the mission leads into the clutches of Szorlok - their greatest enemy - Marek must sacrifice her ambitions and perhaps her own soul to save her friends.

programme.title: Pirates of Somalia
programme.desc: Based on a shocking true story and starring Evan Peters (Xmen franchise), Barkhad Abdi (Captain Philips) and Al Pacino (The Godfather). In search of a unique and worthy story, an aspiring journalist travels to Somalia to write about the life of the Pirates. But he soon becomes embroiled in a dark and dangerous fight which will risk everything, including his life.

programme.title: The Confirmation
programme.desc: A divorced father and his eight-year-old son, spend a rather predictable weekend together, but when a valuable toolbox gets stolen, the search for the thieves will turn into a true family bonding.

programme.title: The Match
programme.desc: "The Match" tells the story of the true events which transpired in the spring of 1944 when Nazis organized a football match between the Hungarian prisoners and an elite Nazi team to commemorate Adolf Hitler's birthday.

programme.title: A Kid Like Jake
programme.desc: Alex Wheeler and her husband Greg (JIM PARSONS) are approaching a crossroads that is all too familiar to New York City parents - finding the "right" primary school for their son, Jake.

programme.title: The Beaver
programme.desc: Two-time Academy Award winner Jodie Foster directs and co-stars with two-time Academy Award winner Mel Gibson in The Beaver - an emotional story about a man on a journey to re-discover his family and re-start his life.

programme.title: Merry and Bright
programme.desc: Cate, the CEO of the Merry and Bright candy cane company, assumes her mother is playing matchmaker again when she meets Gabe in the run-up to Christmas. Stars Andrew Walker and Jodie Sweetin. (2019)

programme.title: Christmas Comes Home
programme.desc: A widower falls for his son's physical rehabilitation specialist.

programme.title: Annie Claus Is Coming To Town
programme.desc: Santa's daughter takes her first trip away from the North Pole during the Christmas season.

programme.title: Dancing Through Christmas
programme.desc: Ballet teacher Olivia gets more than she bargained for during rehearsals for this year's Christmas production when she meets her lead dancer's handsome father. Stars AnnaLynne McCord. (2021)

programme.title: A Christmas Break
programme.desc: (2020) Christmas romance with Cindy Sampson. To save her school from closure, a principal asks a Hollywood star - and former flame - to direct the school play. Will it set the stage for love?

programme.title: Listen Out for Love
programme.desc: Peyton Pepper, a goal-driven podcast producer, is forced to mold Alex McKinney, a brash loose cannon, into her next star and create the perfect show to save both of their careers. That show comes in the form of finding Peyton's iconic idol, true love.

programme.title: Love's Second Chance
programme.desc: Passionate fashion stylist Rose is living her best life in NYC when she suddenly inherits her grandmother's vintage dress shop and must return to her small hometown. There, she runs into her charming high school crush Cole Murphey, who helps her renovate the store.

programme.title: Love at Sunset Terrace
programme.desc: Tired of her fast-paced life in the city, Sophie Carter travels to a small seaside town to disconnect and self-reflect, staying at an Airbnb run by a widowed father of a young girl.

programme.title: The Beauty Of Love
programme.desc: Emma has a lifestyle website that she puts her heart and soul into called “Classically Emma”. But when her numbers start trending down, she thinks she might've found her fix in a partnership with an ambitious millennial named Jill who has her own dreams.

programme.title: Love Wedding Marriage
programme.desc: A happy newlywed marriage counselor's views on wedded bliss get thrown for a loop when she finds out her parents are getting divorced. Starring: Mandy Moore, Kellan Lutz, James Brolin

programme.title: Miss Me This Christmas
programme.desc: Regina moves into her friend's suite at The Chesterton Hotel as she waits for her divorce settlement to come through on Christmas Day. While there, she starts a whirlwind romance with a billionaire, who proposes to her.

programme.title: A Candlelit Christmas
programme.desc: Ellie, a perfume maker, travels back home for Christmas and help her dad with the business. Little does she know, that Logan is staying with him. As Ellie's attempts to learn about her family, Logan helps her realize that fairy tales do indeed exist!

programme.title: A Good Woman
programme.desc: The seductive Mrs. Erlynne (Helen Hunt) travels to Amalfi, Italy, hoping to win over married aristocrat Robert Windermere. But when Windermere's innocent wife Meg (Scarlett Johansson) hears of the scandal, she plots an elaborate revenge.

programme.title: Secret Lives of Second Wives
programme.desc: Lynn finds that marriage the second time around is far from idyllic when her husband's (Brian McNamara) ex-wife and children return to manipulate him.

programme.title: Blueprint To The Heart
programme.desc: An interior designer trying to save her home renovation show needs to apply her successful, upscale "fixer upper" home renovation strategy to her blue collar carpenter by making the sweet but disheveled guy her next fixer upper project.

programme.title: Eat, Drink And Be Married
programme.desc: Three days from their wedding, Jess and Max are about to call it off. However, Jess starts to question her decision when Max's brother enlists the help of Billie to save the wedding, and in the process starts to fall for her.

programme.title: Art Of Falling In Love
programme.desc: An artist painting a mural on a new hospital wing falls for the project's architect but worries he may not want to be with her if she reveals the unfortunate story behind her secret bucket list.

programme.title: All For Love
programme.desc: Jaded romance novelist Jo Payden has a tight deadline for her latest novel. Her last novel wasn't a big success so when her editor Diana recommends teaming up Colin, a Navy SEAL who also happens to be her brother, she jumps at the opportunity. Jo's enthusiasm quickly turns to dread as she realizes that Colin has signed her up for his Navy SEAL training Boot Camp.

programme.title: Under the Bed
programme.desc: Heartbroken woman unknowingly befriends stalker. True story. Stars Hannah New.

programme.title: A Killer Among Us
programme.desc: Alex, post her mom's murder, aims to normalize life for her siblings.

programme.title: A House on Fire
programme.desc: Deborah had the epitome of a perfect life. But not everything is as it seems.

programme.title: Obsessions Gone Too Far
programme.desc: Shortly after earning her degree at Northern Kentucky University.

programme.title: Under the Bed
programme.desc: Heartbroken woman unknowingly befriends stalker. True story. Stars Hannah New.

programme.title: Flowers & Honey
programme.desc: Florist Sarah inherits a ranch and must decide whether to sell it, or live the life of her dreams.

programme.title: Eve of Abduction
programme.desc: When a single mother gets engaged, she receives a threat—break off the engagement or her daughter is kidnapped.

programme.title: Fatal Memories
programme.desc: Psychological thriller. A woman tries to help her sister remember the events surrounding the fatal stabbing of their mother.

programme.title: Happily Never After
programme.desc: True crime writer, Kate, believes her children book writing days with her ex-boyfriend, Josh, are long over until her publisher requests a sequel. When problems begin to rise during the creative process, Kate and Josh decide to relive their past forcing them to fall in love all over again.

programme.title: Jack And Jill
programme.desc: Jack Sadelstein (Adam Sandler) has his normal tranquil life turned upside down when his twin sister Jill (also Adam Sandler) arrives for visit.

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) meets the girl of his dreams (Brooklyn Decker) but has to enlist his loyal assistant Katherine (Jennifer Aniston) to pretend to be his soon-to-be ex-wife in order to cover up a careless lie. When more lies backfire, Katherine's kids become involved, and everyone heads off to Hawaii for a ridiculous, out-of-control weekend that tests the limits of how far we'll go for love.

programme.title: A Dog's Way Home
programme.desc: A dog travels 400 miles in search of her owner.

programme.title: Sydney White
programme.desc: In a college comedy that puts a modern-day twist on an age-old story, Sydney White tells the tale of a tomboy freshman who ditches her conniving sorority sisters and finds a new home with a group of very dorky outcasts. Fed up with the way they've all been treated, she's off to war against the reigning campus royalty.

programme.title: The Internship
programme.desc: Billy (Vince Vaughn) and Nick (Owen Wilson) are salesmen whose careers have been torpedoed by the digital world. Trying to prove they are not obsolete, they defy the odds by talking their way into a coveted internship at Google, along with a battalion of brilliant college students.

programme.title: The Bounce Back
programme.desc: A relationship guru and best-selling author finds himself falling for the licensed therapist who questions his methods.

programme.title: Big Momma's House
programme.desc: FBI agent Malcolm Turner is known best for being a brilliant, master of disguise. Malcolm's latest assignment sends him to small-town Georgia, where he's assigned to trap a brutal bank robber who the FBI suspects will be coming down to visit his ex-girlfriend Sherry and her son.

programme.title: Mother's Day
programme.desc: There are only a few days left before the Mother's Day, as several families have to come to terms with how they'll be spending the big day.

programme.title: The Phantom Gunslinger
programme.desc: Tucca Flats is thrown into chaos when bandits take over and the sheriff flees, leaving clueless Bill in charge. Unarmed and untrained, he faces the gang with strange tools and unexpected allies - finding an unconventional way to fight back.

programme.title: More Dollars for the MacGregors
programme.desc: Forsythe, who uses his wife as bait, has gained a reputation as a gunslinger.

programme.title: Cjamango
programme.desc: Just when Cjamango has won a bag of gold in a poker game, he is attacked by the gangs of El Tigre and Don Pablo.

programme.title: Dead are Countless
programme.desc: As a child, Johnny witnessed his father's death at the hands of soldiers. Now an outlaw, he seeks revenge by killing soldiers whenever possible. Lieutenant Garringo is tasked with capturing Johnny and bringing him back alive. A dangerous game of cat and mouse ensues, with Garringo determined to fulfill his mission.

programme.title: Happiest Days of Your Life
programme.desc: Confusion at The Ministry results in a girls school being joined with a boys school.

programme.title: The Riddle of the Sands
programme.desc: Two sailors become suspicious when they meet off the north coast of Germany.

programme.title: Upstairs and Downstairs
programme.desc: On marrying the boss's daughter, Richard takes his father-in-law's advice to hire a live-in domestic. He soon finds good help is hard to come by and when Ingrid arrives from Sweden things start to get complicated.

programme.title: The Greenman
programme.desc: Hawkins felt the need to eliminate the pompous. Business prospered until the war brought enforced retirement.

programme.title: Vampires Kiss
programme.desc: Lucas Blackmer, a babe-magnet, professor and a novelist asks Sydney to help find Vlad Tepes' lost relic. And he isn't the only one after it.

programme.title: Mr. Right
programme.desc: Sydney runs into her ex Gray and goes on a holiday with him to Bali, but when Derek Lloyd shows up to enlist her to find Parvati's Bowl, she can't resist.

programme.title: Sydney at Ten
programme.desc: Sydney's roommate from school is on track of a pendant from her past and enlists Sydney to help find it and catch the killer.

programme.title: The Light of Truth
programme.desc: Arabia 843 AD: A sheik uses the Light of Truth to reveal his general as a traitor. 2001: Prince Shareem drops out from Sydney's class to go search for the Light of Truth.

programme.title: Treasure Island
programme.desc: Sydney's on the hunt for a Pirate's booty, but will a traitor force her to walk the plank?

programme.title: Women Want to Know
programme.desc: Sydney has found a temple with an idol of Ganesha and it is being filmed for TV, but they get trapped inside when the local rebels stumble onto them. Can Nigel and Karen help from USA?

programme.title: The Star of Nadir
programme.desc: An anonymous Sultan's wife Danielle dies in mysterious circumstances in the desert. However, she had called for Sydney to help. Sydney believes Danielle was searching for the Star of Nadir.

programme.title: Devil Doll
programme.desc: A guide leads Sydney and Nigel to an unusual, underground Aztec burial chamber. Instead of a body, they find a relic.

programme.title: The Missing Sister
programme.desc: When Sharon finally tracks down her missing sister Raven, she's elated to be back together – until she begins to suspect that Raven isn't her sister at all, but rather an opportunistic imposter.

programme.title: The Double
programme.desc: An edge-of-your-seat espionage thriller, starring Richard Gere and Topher Grace as ex-CIA and FBI agents, trying to find the killer of a US senator, which bears the hallmark of an infamous Soviet assassin, thought to be dead.

programme.title: Warriors' Gate
programme.desc: American teenager Jack Bronson is magically transported to ancient China, where he must become a hero and rescue a beautiful princess from the clutches of the evil barbarian king.

programme.title: Birth of the Dragon
programme.desc: In the world of martial arts, there is one man above all: Bruce Lee. San Francisco, 1965.

programme.title: Suspect (1987)
programme.desc: This tension-filled courtroom drama opens with the suicide of a Supreme Court justice. Then the young Justice Department employee to whom he had given privileged information is discovered dead. A deaf-mute Vietnam veteran is charged with her murder and Cher, a public defender, is appointed counsel.

programme.title: Ivanhoe (1982)
programme.desc: Sir Walter Scott's epic novel of timeless romance and knightly daring comes to life! The year is 1194. At long last, the noble knight Wilfred of Ivanhoe (Anthony Andrews) has returned from the Crusades to regain his title and win the hand of his beloved Lady Rowena (Lysette Anthony).

programme.title: Searching (2018)
programme.desc: 37 hours after David Kim's (John Cho) 16-year-old daughter goes missing without a single lead, David decides to search the one place no one has looked yet, where all secrets are kept today: his daughter's laptop.

programme.title: The Exorcism Of Emily Rose
programme.desc: A thrilling horror film about a lawyer (Linney), who takes on a negligent homicide case involving a priest (Wilkinson) who performed an exorcism on a young girl.

programme.desc: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

programme.title: Spotlight [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 2001, editor Marty Baron of The Boston Globe assigns a team of journalists to investigate allegations against John Geoghan, an unfrocked priest accused of molesting more than 80 boys. Led by editor Walter "Robby" Robinson (Michael Keaton), reporters Michael Rezendes (Mark Ruffalo), Matt Carroll and Sacha Pfeiffer interview victims and try to unseal sensitive documents. The reporters make it their mission to provide proof of a cover-up of sexual abuse within the Roman Catholic Church.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: Freejack [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Early in the 21st century, technological advances have made it possible for aging, wealthy people to pay crooks like Vacendak (Mick Jagger) to go back in time, kidnap young victims like race car driver Alex Furlong (Emilio Estevez) and deliver them to the elderly clients, who then have their brains transplanted into the healthy bodies. Furlong manages to break free from his captors, but as a fugitive, he finds that the world of the future is a bleak, dangerous place.

programme.title: Transsiberian
programme.desc: On their way home from China, married Christian missionaries Roy (Woody Harrelson) and Jessie (Emily Mortimer) take a train from Beijing to Moscow. On board, they befriend Carlos (Eduardo Noriega) and Abby (Kate Mara). When Roy does not return in time at one stop, Jessie waits for him to catch up at the next station. Carlos and Abby stay with her, insisting the town is unsafe, however Carlos' attempts to "befriend" Jessie radically change the dynamic of the trip.

programme.title: Assault On Precinct 13 [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: The lone inhabitants of an abandoned police station are under attack by the overwhelming numbers of a seemingly unstoppable street gang.

programme.title: Cover-Up [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: A tough ex-U.S. Marine journalist battles against time to save the lives of thousands of innocent people after uncovering a complex terrorist plot.

programme.desc: Un jeune homme riche engage une aide-soignante apparemment parfaite pour prendre soin de sa mère malade.

programme.title: Un mari aux deux visages
programme.desc: Le mari d'une femme disparaît lors d'une excursion en kayak. Lorsqu'elle aperçoit un homme qui lui ressemble, sa vie est bouleversée.

programme.title: Lucky Peterson & The Organization
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city. In 2019, one of these artists is the legendary bluesman Lucky Peterson, master of the blues guitar and Hammond organ, who celebrates 50 years on stage. Peterson is accompanied by his band The Organization, augmented by the talented vocalist Tamara Tramell. In a singular performance, she offers a fascinating mix of southern soul and modern R&B, exploring the limits of blues and funk.

programme.title: Mike Stern
programme.sub-title: Mike Stern & Didier Lockwood: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Guitarist Mike Stern and violin player Didier Lockwood sharing a stage: that promises a good show! After playing for years with Blood, Sweat & Tears, Mike Stern landed a gig with drummer Billy Cobham and then broke through with Miles Davis' comeback band in the 1980s. Didier Lockwood played in jazz fusion band Magma during the 1970s and is known for his use of electric amplification and experimentation. Together they perform a unique duo concert at the beautiful antique theatre in Vienne, France.

programme.title: Gilberto Gil
programme.desc: Brazilian artist Gilberto Gil returns to Jazz à Vienne in France with a new round of singing that is inspired by his latest album ‘Fé na Festa': a mixture of celebration, tradition and even some rock now and then. Gilberto Gil, worldwide known for as musician and the Brazilian minister of Culture, was one of the pioneers of the cultural movement ‘tropicalismo'. This movement, with a strong character of social protest, combines elements of traditional Brazilian culture with modern art forms. Gilberto Gil's new sound clearly has its roots in Brazilian culture, yet it is always inspired by jazz.

programme.title: Paul Desmond
programme.desc: An extraordinary collection of clips in all jazz genres from the most beautiful concerts and the most special festivals, performed by the finest jazz musicians.

programme.title: Chucho Valdés
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2' to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Batá'. The batá repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valdés' piano solos throughout the concert. Valdés's band consists of Dreiser Durruthy (Batas and vocals), Yaroldy Abreu (percussions and vocals), Abraham Mansfarroll (percussion), Ramón Vazquez Martirena-Bajo (bass guitar). They delivered a performance that reverberated through the historic island.

programme.title: Gerry Mulligan, Dave Glenn, Harold Danko & Ed Neumeister
programme.sub-title: Gerry Mulligan Big Band - The North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival's staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, American saxophonist Gerry Mulligan gave an unforgettable performance at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague. Mulligan was one of the leading arrangers of the cool jazz era, who worked with Miles Davis, Stan Kenton and Claude Thornhill in the 1950s and 1960s. Mulligan's early pianoless 1950s quartet with trumpeter Chet Baker is still regarded as one of the finest groups in cool jazz. Born in New York in 1927, Mulligan spent his life composing, arranging and playing jazz until his death on January 20, 1996.

programme.title: Jose James, Takuya Kuroda, Solomon Dorsey & Kris Bowers
programme.desc: ‘Jazz a Vienne' is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981 it has attracted leading jazz artists, with many of them playing return engagements. Unsurprisingly, the festival's 2013 edition did not fall short of expectations: the lineup was filled with the biggest names in music. Among them was Jose James. He was discovered by the legendary DJ and radio broadcaster Gilles Peterson. Joined on stage by Takuya Kuroda on trumpet, Solomon Dorsey on bass, Kris Bowers on keys, and Richard Spaven on drums, the singer is one of the prime examples of the direction jazz is heading towards.

programme.title: Thelonious Monk, Charlie Rouse, Ben Riley & Larry Gales
programme.desc: The idiosyncratic pianist and composer Thelonious Monk (1917-1982) is one of the all-time greats of jazz. His music went largely misunderstood for the first 15 years of his career, after which he was rightly hailed as a genius, and received credit as a founding father of bebop. Several concerts from his 1966 European tour were recorded for television, featuring his quartet of Charles Rouse (tenor saxophone), Lawrence Gales (bass) and Benjamin Riley (drums). His quartet performed Epistrophy, 'Round Midnight, and Lulu's Back in Town in Warsaw for Polish television on April 4, 1966. On April 17, the same quartet performed a short set in Copenhagen for Danish television, featuring Lulu's Back in Town, Don't Blame Me, and Epistrophy.

programme.title: The Kenny Garrett Quintet
programme.desc: Appearing in the early 1980s at a time when some of jazz was refocusing on some of its historic values, Kenny Garrett was the first to show, through the dramatic intensity of his playing, that the alto could once again compete with the tenor saxophone, the instrument par excellence of the quest for jazz since John Coltrane, a musician whose influence he loudly and clearly claims. "Sounds from the Ancestors" his latest album, reflects the rich history of jazz, R&B and gospel music from the saxophonist's hometown of Detroit. But more importantly, it also has a modern cosmopolitan vibe, including music from France, Cuba, Nigeria and Guadeloupe.

programme.title: Sir Simon Rattle & London Symphony Orchestra
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67
programme.desc: Sir Simon Rattle conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven's well-known Symphony No. 5 in C minor, Op. 67. With Sir Simon Rattle's mischievous enthusiasm, this famous heavyweight symphony sounds new again. This performance was recorded at LSO St. Luke's in London, UK, on September 23, 2020.

programme.title: Silvia Chiesa & Maurizio Baglini
programme.desc: Italian cellist Silvia Chiesa and Italian pianist Maurizio Baglini perform a wonderful recital of works by Ferruccio Busoni, Franz Liszt, Frédéric Chopin, and Sergei Rachmaninoff. On the program are Busoni's Kultaselle – 10 variations on a Finnish folksong Liszt's Two Elegies for cello and piano Chopin's Introduction and Polonaise brillante in C major, Op. 3 and Rachmaninoff's Sonata in G minor for cello and piano, Op. 19. As an encore, the duo plays Leonard Bernstein's iconic composition ‘Tonight' from the musical West Side Story. This performance was recorded at Sala Verdi of the Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi in Milan, Italy, on November 4, 2024.

programme.title: David Bateson, Tuva Semmingsen, Cassandra Lemoine & Bjørn Fjæstad
programme.sub-title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program. Under the baton of German conductor Christian Schumann, the Danish National Symphony Orchestra, Danish National Concert Choir, and Danish National Junior Choir team up to perform music from the most popular fantasy movies, TV series and video games, including The Lord of The Rings, Game of Thrones, The Hobbit, The Witcher, and League of Legends. Featured soloists in this concert are Norwegian mezzo-soprano Tuva Semmingsen, Canadian-Portuguese soprano Cassandra Lemoine, Danish musician Bjørn Fjæstad, and British actor David Bateson. This performance was recorded at the DR Koncerthuset in Copenhagen, Denmark, in April 2023.

programme.title: Teodor Currentzis, Patricia Kopatchinskaja & Ensemble Musica Aeterna
programme.sub-title: Beauty is a Crime: Mendelssohn & Brahms
programme.desc: Greek conductor Teodor Currentzis leads his ensemble MusicAeterna alongside Austrian-Moldovan violinist Patricia Kopatchinskaja in a performance showcasing young, accomplished and energetic musicians. For this concert, they went searching for a new definition of the meaning of the word beauty. Thus, this 2015 performance from the renowned Musikfest Bremen sheds an entirely new light on two beloved classics by Brahms and Mendelssohn. The concert programme features Felix Mendelssohn's Violin Concerto in E minor and Johannes Brahms's Symphony No. 3 in F Major.

programme.title: Philippe Jordan & Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris
programme.sub-title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68
programme.desc: Swiss conductor Philippe Jordan and the Orchestre de l'Opéra national de Paris recorded all of Ludwig van Beethoven's symphonies in 2014-2015. In this program, Jordan conducts Beethoven's Symphony No. 6 in F major, Op. 68, also known as the Pastoral Symphony. Beethoven wrote the work upon completion of his Symphony No. 5. Both symphonies premiered at the same legendary, all-Beethoven concert on December 22, 1808. Symphony No. 6 consists of five movements, of which the last three are played without a break. Each movement carries a title that suggests a scene from life in the countryside. The joyful atmosphere of the first three movements is interrupted by the violent fourth movement ‘Thunder, Storm', as expressed by the piccolos, brass, and timpani. As the storm recedes at the end of the movement, the tranquility returns in the final movement. This performance was recorded at Opéra Bastille in Paris, France, in 2015.

programme.title: Isabel Schwartzbach, Eivør Pálsdóttir & Adam Riis
programme.desc: Explore the captivating sounds of epic gaming worlds brought to life by 150 musicians and singers at DR Koncerthuset. The Danish National Symphony Orchestra transforms the stage into enchanted musical landscapes inspired by legendary video games such as The Legend of Zelda and League of Legends, featuring Nordic vocalist Eivør as a special guest in Legends Never Die and more.

programme.title: Led Zeppelin
programme.desc: This is a documentary film about the build-up, making, release, and - crucially - music contained on this most revered of albums. With the aid of rare and classic performances, scarce interviews, seldom seen photographs and contributions from those involved in the making of the record - plus the review and critique from a panel of Zeppelin experts - this program finally lifts the lid on what many believe to be Led Zep's very finest offering. With contributions from the album's engineer, Ron Nevison former Yardbird, Chris Dreja Swansong recording artist, Maggie Bell author of The Rough Guide to Led Zeppelin, Nigel Williamson Tight But Loose editor, Dave Lewis Classic Rock Magazine's Malcolm Dome renowned guitar tutor and author, Rikky Rooksby and Robert Plant biographer, Neil Daniels. This is the complete story behind what what Rolling Stone called "their Tommy, Beggar's Banquet and Sgt. Pepper rolled into one".

programme.title: David Gilmour

programme.title: Rush
programme.desc: Rush's 'Time Machine' shows in 2010/11 were one of the most anticipated tours ever. Celebrating 30 years since the 1981 release of their classic bestselling album 'Moving Pictures' the band performed the entire album live for the first time as the centrepiece of the concerts. The shows also featured favourite tracks from across their lengthy career and two recent ones. As ever the concerts were a visual feast and sounded great with the band playing at the top of their form.

programme.title: En primera línea
programme.desc: Situé au Viêt Nam en avril 1968, trois mois après l'offensive du Têt et un mois après l'assassinat de Martin Luther King Jr, Point Man raconte l'histoire d'une équipe de pompiers de l'armée américaine fracturée par les tensions raciales, les crises morales et les pressions écrasantes du combat dans une guerre que personne ne veut mener. Andre « Casper » Allen, un idéologue brutal, est en désaccord avec Silas Meeks, le mitrailleur de l'escouade, en raison de ses idées radicales. Lorsque leur mission de recherche et de destruction dans le delta du Mékong tourne mal, les deux hommes se retrouvent opposés l'un à l'autre et à leur chef de section récalcitrant, le lieutenant Sutter. Les hommes de pointe meurent comme des mouches dans la brousse, et à mesure que les loyautés se dissolvent, chaque pas en avant a un prix.

programme.desc: A finales del siglo XV, el juglar Gilles y su amiga Dominique aparecen misteriosamente en el castillo del barón Hugues mientras…

programme.desc: Un elegante play boy y una bella cantante de un club nocturno se conocen a bordo de un transatlántico, gracias a la invitación de otras dos personas. Ella es la amante de un magnate y él está comprometido con una rica heredera. Entre ellos surge un apasionante romance que los llevará a la siguiente promesa: romper con sus compromisos actuales, buscar trabajo y encontrarse a los seis meses, para continuar su vida juntos. Pero un trágico accidente impide a Terry acudir a la cita, con lo que el futuro de ambos sufrirá un giro emotivo e incierto.

programme.title: Voyage of time: el viaje de la vida
programme.desc: Del nacimiento de las estrellas a la evolución de la vida sobre la Tierra, el primer documental del prestigioso cineasta Terrence Malick es una obra magna que ahonda ni más ni menos que en los misterios de la creación. Malick sigue la línea de las fascinantes imágenes que poblaban “El árbol de la vida”, viaja al espacio y escudriña la Tierra.

programme.title: El tercer asesinato
programme.desc: El conocido abogado Shigemori defiende a Misumi, acusado de robo con homicidio, que ya cumplió pena de cárcel por otro asesinato hace treinta años.

programme.title: Happy End
programme.desc: A nuestro alrededor, el mundo, y nosotros en medio, ciegos. Una instantánea de la vida de una familia burguesa europea.

programme.title: Alpha
programme.desc: Tres amigos se ven obligados a separarse tras un atraco frustrado. Ocho años más tarde, el destino los vuelve a unir a pesar de haber tomado caminos muy distintos.

programme.title: La decisión de Sophie
programme.desc: Ganadora del Oscar a Mejor Actriz (Meryl Streep) y dirigida por Alan Pakula (El informe Pelícano). Stingo, un joven con ambiciones literarias se traslada a Brooklyn, donde conoce a una inmigrante polaca llamada Sophie, una superviviente de Auschwitz...

programme.title: Becky
programme.desc: Adolescente defiende su hogar de convictos.

programme.title: Cuatro Vidas
programme.desc: Según un proverbio chino, la existencia humana se divide en cuatro emociones: felicidad, placer, pena y amor.

programme.title: Doble Identidad
programme.desc: Un médico en Chechenia por motivos laborales, ve un asalto y ayuda a la joven y misteriosa víctima a huir.

programme.title: El Caso Wanninkhof: Una doble tragedia
programme.desc: Rocío Wanninkhof, una joven de 19 años, se despide de su novio después de haber pasado la tarde juntos.

programme.title: La diligencia: La historia de Texas Jack
programme.desc: El ex ladrón de diligencias, Nathaniel Reed inicia una vida honesta junto su esposa Laura, pero no durará.

programme.title: La Gran Apuesta
programme.desc: Basada en la historia real de 4 desconocidos que vieron lo que rechazaron los grandes bancos y el gobierno: el derrumbamiento mundial de la economía.

programme.title: Negocios con resaca
programme.desc: Desmadre de comedia gamberra y transgresora con Vince Vaughn como el sufrido dueño de un pequeño negocio quien, junto con sus dos socios, viajan a Europa para cerrar el acuerdo más importante de sus vidas. Pero lo que comenzó como un viaje de negocios de rutina descarrila en inimaginables caminos.

programme.title: Contra
programme.desc: El profesor Richard Pohl se hace viral tras un comentario xenófobo en clase: insulta a Naima Hamid, estudiante de Derecho, delante de todos sus compañeros.

programme.title: El agente
programme.desc: En el año 2030, el mundo se encuentra en perenne estado de recesión económica y se enfrenta a problemas medioambientales. Todos los ciudadanos improductivos son exiliados a una colonia.

programme.title: El super canguro
programme.desc: Bob Ho es un superespía secreto de la CIA que decide abandonar su carrera para sentar la cabeza con su novia, Gillian. Pero Bob tiene una última misión que cumplir antes de que Gillian acepte casarse con él: ganarse a sus tres testarudos hijos.

programme.title: Fremont
programme.desc: Comedia dramática con una historia llena humanidad y optimismo. Donya es una ex traductora afgana del gobierno de Estados Unidos que ahora vive sola en Fremont, California.

programme.title: Hermosas criaturas
programme.desc: Siguiendo la línea de 'Crepúsculo', 'Hermosas criaturas' es un cuento de amores contrariados que esconde un oscuro y peligroso secreto. Ethan Wate es un adolescente que sueña con escapar de su rutinaria vida en la pequeña localidad de Gatlin, hasta que conoce a Lena Duchannes.

programme.title: Decisión final
programme.desc: El día del sorteo de la NFL, el director general Sonny Weaver (Costner) tiene la oportunidad de salvar el fútbol americano en Cleveland al negociar la primera selección.

programme.title: El Benefactor
programme.desc: La historia de un nostálgico filántropo (Richard Gere) que se involucra y se hace hueco en la vida de un matrimonio recién casado, Olivia (Dakota Fanning) y Luke (Theo James), buscando con ello recuperar experiencias vitales que antaño tuvo.

programme.title: Lejos de la tierra quemada
programme.desc: Ópera prima de Guillermo Arriaga como director. Cuatro intensas historias en torno al amor.

programme.title: El Puente de San Luis Rey
programme.desc: Cuando el puente de San Luis se derrumba, los viajeros caen al abismo.

programme.title: Cariño, cuánto te odio
programme.desc: Rivales laborales descubren el amor.

programme.title: Me Quiere, No Me Quiere
programme.desc: Un mujeriego vuelve a casa por vacaciones y se enreda con la mujer que le rompió el corazón años atrás.

programme.title: Seducción a la carta
programme.desc: La magia y la risa son los ingredientes principales de esta historia de amor sobre una propietaria y chef de un restaurante y un jefe de departamento de una tienda que no parecen tener nada en común.

programme.title: El Forastero (The Outsider)
programme.desc: Montana, finales del siglo XIX. El poderoso ganadero Fergus Hunter hace y deshace a su antojo en el condado. Decidido a comprar las tierras de unos colonos Amish pasará de la extorsión al asesinato.

programme.title: Lecciones de amor
programme.desc: Comedia dramática sobre dos profesores: él de inglés (Clive Owen) y ella de arte (Juliette Binoche), que sostienen dos puntos de vista diametralmente opuestos se enfrentan en una especie de batalla para dirimir si son más importantes las palabras o las imágenes y la chispa entre ellos se enciende..

programme.title: Un hombre solitario
programme.desc: Un ejecutivo cincuentón y venido a menos intenta superar los tiempos difíciles y volver a centrarse en su carrera, después de años de excesos en los que el dinero y el sexo, han marcado el inicio de una imparable decadencia personal y profesional.

programme.title: Devuélveme mi suerte
programme.desc: Ashley (Lindsay Lohan) es muy afortunada, tiene muy buena suerte y siempre le ha salido todo bien. Pero un día, Ashley besa a Jake (Chris Pine), el joven con peor suerte de la ciudad, y sus papeles se intercambian...

programme.title: Otro país
programme.desc: En los años 30, dos jóvenes entablan amistad en un colegio británico de clase alta. La homosexualidad del uno y las ideas marxistas y revolucionarias del otro los convertirán en unos "outsiders" en el marco de férrea disciplina victoriana del internado. Años después, se convertirán en espías de la Unión Soviética, usando como tapadera su condición de funcionarios del Gobierno Británico.

programme.title: Mr. Wain
programme.desc: Cuenta la historia real de Louis Wain, un artista británico, inventor y empresario, famoso por sus pinturas de gatos.

programme.title: Space truckers. Transporte espacial
programme.desc: Año 2094. John Canyon es un viajero espacial que recorre la galaxia transportando mercancías. Su misión más arriesgada será transportar un extraño cargamento que puede suponer una grave amenaza para el planeta Tierra.

programme.title: Vitus
programme.desc: Vitus es un chico que parece llegado de otro planeta: tiene un oído como el de un murciélago, toca el piano como un virtuoso y estudia enciclopedias a la edad de cinco años. Como es de suponer, sus padres le anticipan un brillante porvenir quieren que sea pianista. Sin embargo, el pequeño genio prefiere tocar en el taller de su excéntrico abuelo, y sueña con volar y con tener una infancia normal. Finalmente, como consecuencia de un inesperado accidente, Vitus tomará las riendas de su propia vida.

programme.title: Todo Me Pasa A Mí
programme.desc: El regreso de un amigo de la India hace que un grupo de jóvenes se cuestione sus relaciones.

programme.title: Operación Concha
programme.desc: Un estafador atrae a un inversor contratando a un doble de una estrella de cine.

programme.title: Hojas de Hierba
programme.desc: Las vidas de dos gemelos cambian cuando el profesor de filosofía es confundido un traficante de drogas.

programme.title: Los tigres del tren
programme.desc: Un ferroviario en la China de 1941 lucha contra los japoneses para lograr comida para los pobres.

programme.title: Coffee Wars
programme.desc: Una barista vegana se enfrenta al mundo en el Campeonato Mundial de Baristas.

programme.title: De vuelta a casa
programme.desc: Alice (Reese Witherspoon) es una mujer recién separada que decide enfrentarse a nuevos retos y vuelve a Los Ángeles para construirse una nueva vida. Un nuevo trabajo que no es exactamente lo que ella esperaba, un colegio nuevo para sus hijos y facturas que pagar.

programme.title: Seducción a la carta
programme.desc: La magia y la risa son los ingredientes principales de esta historia de amor sobre una propietaria y chef de un restaurante y un jefe de departamento de una tienda que no parecen tener nada en común.

programme.title: Atraco por duplicado
programme.desc: Tripp Kennedy entra tranquilamente en una sucursal bancaria poco antes de la hora de cierre, justo en el momento en que dos bandas distintas convergen por casualidad con intención de realizar un atraco. Todos ellos quedan atrapados en el edificio durante una noche que promete acción y diversión...

programme.title: Más extraño que la ficción
programme.desc: Una mañana, un agente de Hacienda aparentemente normal y generalmente solitario llamado Harold Crick empieza a escuchar una voz femenina que narra todas sus acciones, pensamientos y sentimientos con un detalle alarmantemente preciso.

programme.title: Magnolias de Acero
programme.desc: Seis mujeres sureñas se mantienen en pie gracias a su amistad y lealtad a través de los ciclos de la vida, el matrimonio, el Nacimiento y la Muerte.

programme.title: High School High
programme.desc: Richard Clark es un profesor idealista que trabaja como maestro en una elitista escuela y decide trasladarse al instituto más conflictivo y rebelde de uno de los barrios marginales de la ciudad. Allí, su inocente personalidad y sus sorprendentes técnicas de enseñanza dejarán perplejos a todos los estudiantes y el profesorado. Clark lucha por ser comprendido y no pierde la esperanza de convertir a los alumnos gandules en genios.

programme.title: El Romance De Murphy
programme.desc: Lo último que Emma Moriarty (Sally Field) esperaba encontrar en Eunice, Arizona, era el amor. Pero cuando ella y su hijo (Corey Haim) se mudan a la ciudad, repentinamente descubre que es objeto de las atenciones de Murphy Jones (Garner) .

programme.title: Paternidad
programme.desc: Kevin Hart protagoniza esta conmovedora historia real sobre un padre viudo que se enfrenta a dudas, miedos, angustias y pañales sucios mientras se dispone a criar a su hija por su cuenta.

programme.title: Un deseo de matar
programme.desc: Un vaquero se escapa de la cárcel con la ayuda de su novia, y va tras los hombres que cree que son responsables de que su hermano sea abatido por los agentes de la ley.

programme.title: Recopilación Bonanza Episodios 19, 20, 22
programme.desc: Las aventuras del Salvaje Oeste de Ben Cartwright y sus hijos mientras dirigen y defienden su rancho de Nevada al tiempo que ayudan a la comunidad de los alrededores.

programme.title: El cazador de forajidos
programme.desc: Una banda que trabaja para La Sombra está aterrorizando al pueblo. John Travers decide asumir el trabajo de sheriff y hacer algo al respecto.

programme.title: La reina de Montana
programme.desc: Sierra Nevada Jones debe luchar contra un malvado ranchero para reclamar la tierra que por derecho le pertenece.

programme.title: Doc West
programme.desc: Después de ser despojado de sus ganancias en un juego de póquer, Doc West busca venganza. Durante una partida en un pueblo, acaba en la cárcel, y cuando su pasado se revela, el pueblo estalla en una batalla a tiros. Doc deberá decidir si unirse a los forajidos o apoyar a los ciudadanos honrados.

Leo está en crisis con su pareja. Trabaja doce horas por día como chófer de taxi en Rosario. La ciudad está cambiando, y eso lo agobia. Un suceso imprevisto en su taxi lo obliga a modiﬁcar su rutina. En las calles de la tensa ciudad se cruza con situaciones que agudizan su malestar. Siempre se ha contenido, ahora parece a punto de explotar.

programme.title: Locas y Atrapadas
programme.desc: Cinco mujeres quedan atrapadas en un ascensor y comparten historias de sus vidas.

programme.title: Soy Judio
programme.desc: Una historia apasionante donde la fe y el amor se ponen a prueba. "Soy Judío" es un proyecto cinematográfico de Andariego Films y Parabollum que explora emociones profundas y desafíos personales.

programme.title: El engaño
programme.desc: El policía Mike Santini vive y trabaja en Nueva York. Él y su familia están de vacaciones en el Caribe cuando descubre al criminal fugitivo Eddie Meyers. Santini detiene a Meyers.

programme.title: El día que me perdí
programme.desc: Xochil se enfrenta al peor día de su vida, descubriendo que fue aún más doloroso de lo que recordaba. En su viaje al pasado busca reencontrarse consigo misma y abrir la puerta a recuerdos y verdades que había enterrado. Una historia de introspección, heridas y redescubrimiento personal.

programme.title: La conspiración del silencio
programme.desc: El joven fiscal Johann Radmann encuentra unos documentos que le permiten poner en marcha un proceso judicial contra algunos miembros de las SS que sirvieron en Auschwitz. Pero los horrores del pasado y la hostilidad hacia su trabajo lo llevan cerca del colapso, pues le resulta casi imposible abrirse paso a través de un laberinto en el que todo el mundo parece estar implicado o ser culpable.

programme.title: Mi amigo Blue
programme.desc: Una icónica historia de amistad entre un muchacho y un perro único y desgarbado que se convertiría en una leyenda australiana.

programme.title: El proyecto Colibrí
programme.desc: Dos primos intentan hacerse millonarios mediante la construcción de un cable de fibra óptica entre Kansas y Nueva Jersey, mientras su antigua jefa intenta evitar que lo consigan

programme.title: Éternité
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XIX, Valentine, de 20 años, se casa con Jules. Cien años más tarde, su nieta recorre un puente en París para encontrarse con el hombre que ama. Durante el siglo que las separa, hombres y mujeres se conocen, se enamoran y cruzan sus destinos, creando un árbol genealógico y una fuerza vital que continuará para la eternidad…

programme.title: Negociador
programme.desc: Comedia basada en las negociaciones entre el presidente del PSE vasco, Jesús Eguiguren y ETA en 2005 y 2006.

programme.title: Matria
programme.desc: Ramona vive en un pueblo de Galicia sumida en un contexto laboral y personal tenso e impredecible. Siempre sacrificándolo todo por el futuro de su hija Estrella, se verá empujada a mirar hacia dentro y a pensar que, tal vez, haya algo nuevo por lo que vivir.

programme.title: Un largo viaje (2023)
programme.desc: Una vieja autocaravana será el nuevo hogar de Violeta y Samuel con vistas a un complejo comercial del sur de Madrid, donde tratarán de reconciliarse y hacer frente a la vida con tan solo veintidós euros en el bolsillo y “mucha imaginación”.

programme.title: El amor no es lo que era
programme.desc: Este film narra tres historias de amor urbanas. Álex y Lucía se encuentran, empiezan a conocerse y entre ellos surge un romance. Paz y Jorge ven impotentes cómo su relación se apaga sin saber qué hacer. Finalmente, Albert e Irene vuelven a verse tras varios decenios de separación.

programme.desc: Un maníaco atrapa a una actriz en una limusina y le da órdenes a través de un altavoz distorsionado. Ella debe cumplir con sus demandas trastornadas si alguna vez quiere volver a salir de la limusina.

That discovery pushes the friends on a road trip around town during which they try get rid of the increasing amount of corpses. Along their wild ride the kids encounter neo-Nazis, punk artists, devil worshipers and a plan to resurrect Hitler.

programme.title: El Exorcista III
programme.desc: Una mujer que se arrastra por el techo. Un criminal muerto hace tiempo que asesina víctima tras víctima. Las llamas estallan, las serpientes se deslizan, la tierra se abre revelando el tormentoso infierno. El demonio ha vuelto... pero el sacerdote Damien Karras vuelve a notar la presencia del maligno, y pedirá la ayuda del escéptico detective Kinderman para derrotarle.

programme.title: Ultravioleta
programme.desc: A finales del siglo XXI, surge una subcultura de seres humanos con una mutación genética: están dotados de una asombrosa velocidad, una increíble resistencia y una profunda inteligencia. A medida que hay más personas contagiadas, el temor del gobierno aumenta y a los mutantes se les trata como a marginados, se les somete a pruebas espantosas y se les pone en cuarentena. El gobierno ha tomado la determinación de acabar con ellos, pero una mujer está decidida a impedirlo: la ultrabella y ultraletal Violet. Gracias a sus impresionantes técnicas de artes marciales y a su capacidad camaleónica, Violet se convierte en una guerrera solitaria dedicada a proteger a su nueva raza y a vengarse de los que la crearon.

programme.title: El Libro de Eli
programme.desc: Eli (Denzel Washington), un guerrero solitario, camina en una tierra arrasada por la hecatombe una tierra que una vez fue los Estados Unidos. Se dirige hacia el Oeste para llevar a cabo una misión que no acaba de entender del todo pero que sabe que debe cumplir. Protege con su vida la última copia de un libro sagrado que puede ser la llave para salvar la humanidad. Sólo Carnegie (Gary Oldman), un autoproclamado jefe militar que gobierna una ciudad de ladrones y pistoleros, conoce el poder que Eli tiene en sus manos y ha decidido arrebatárselo. Pero nada puede interponerse en el camino de Eli. Nada puede impedirle cumplir con su destino y ayudar a un mundo arruinado.

programme.title: Una Noche Para Morir
programme.desc: Hace tres años, (Brittany Snow, John Tucker Must Die) vio horrorizada como un depredador obsesionado (Johnathon Schaech, That Thing You Do!) asesinó a su familia. Esta noche es el baile de graduación y aunque está ansiosa por el pasado, también está emocionada por celebrar su futuro con sus amigos. Lo que Donna no sabe es que el desquiciado psicópata ha escapado del asilo y ha vuelto a por ella con la intención de matar a todo el que se interpongo en su camino. Mientras la noche se acerca a su palpitante conclusión, la pregunta no es quién será la reina del baile, sino quién sobrevivirá a la masacre del asesino.
